notes: Native firmware 0.1.32 — the block-reply patience rework: the truncated-0x08 path no longer flushes the UART (the P349 drain destroyed late-arriving offset bytes of the display's resume request) and waits out incomplete replies up to 1.5s of silence inside a 5s cap; every block reply is hex+position logged. Back to 115200 with a single blocking write per block (the historical 66% configuration). The baud restore to 115200 now happens at every attempt start and on the failure exit — after 0.1.31's failed attempt the ESP stayed at 57600 while the power-cycled display boots at 115200, so attempts 2-3 failed no-comok for nothing but the baud mismatch. Carries all prior fixes.

bug_fixes: 0.1.7/0.1.8: the boot reset reason is visible on the panel's web UI after every boot; TFT updates are refused while the display is not responding.
